t: Question the Goblin Workers about the mafia and return to Afanasy Firov.

The Empire is trying to build a wall around their camp... As if that will help them any!
But, actually, I want to talk to you about something else. They're using goblins as construction workers, makes sense, right? Totalitarianism breeds slavery. The Light had left them so long ago but they don't even notice it!
But then again, those goblins aren't as stupid as they seem. I'm certain that they're connected to the mafia that manufactures weapons to the east of here.
Naturally, the goblins can't stand working for the Empire - this is something we can make use of! Get to those goblins and try to shake them down for any information on the mafia. Most of them will probably keep their mouths shut, but I'm sure there'll be a black sheep or two in their midst - the kind who won't mind selling out his own kind.
Did the goblins give up any info?

This is certainly valuable information... As soon as we deal with the Empire, we'll be turning out attention to the mafia.
We cannot allow the League to miss even a single artifact!
Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in charge! I'm just a simple worker just trying to earn some coin!
Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in charge! I'm just a simple worker just trying to earn some coin!

Alright, I'll tell you everything, just don't beat me anymore! The mafia runs the show here. They have all of the dark artifacts. They carry them to the distant anomalies beyond the Cordon!
Do you want those artifacts? Well, you should ask them for them, but I'm sure they won't give them to you for free! You better be ready for a tough fight!
Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in charge! I'm just a simple worker just trying to earn some coin!
Sneak into the Imperial goblin camp and kill 6 Imperial Supervisors for the Gallant Family in the League camp.

The Empire has been sending more and more spies into our camp to try carry out sabotage missions, like burning tents and poisoning our water.
Is this their idea of war? They should be ashamed of themselves!
Our hearts are heavy with this decision, but we are forced to ask you to visit the enemy camp and give them a taste of their own medicine.
The perfect sabotage is already waiting for you. The Empire has decided to erect a wall around their camp and they've got goblins doing the building. But the moment we kill off their supervisors, the goblin workers will disperse from the site in a matter of seconds!
The Empire will regret the day they recruited goblins!
Their construction has been shut down. Hurray! Let this unfinished wall remain on the plateau as a monument to Imperial arrogance!
Sneak into the Imperial camp and use the Speculum of Light on 3 Boxes of Dark Artifacts for the Gallant Family.

All the artifacts that the Empire has gathered are stored in their camp depot. I shudder to think that any one of them could be used against the League here or on any other allod. Why, oh, why doesn't the Church allow us to make use of their power... We just don't understand...
However, we were brainstorming with Azarias the other day and we thought of a way to ensure that the artifacts are never used against us. The Church agreed and has given us a holy artifact! If we hide the artifact somewhere near the Imperial depot, its holy might will be enough to disable dozens of dark artifacts. Can we entrust you with a mission of this magnitude?
Just be careful, the Speculum of Light is a very powerful and precious artifact. It must not fall into the Empire's hands.
Just imagine, the Imperial forces will keep bringing more and more artifacts to their base and they'll all lose their power! Crafty, ain't it?!
Disguise yourself as a defector, infiltrate the Prospectors at the Prospectors' Inn, and explore the Anomalies beyond the Cordon for Semer Kiya in the Imperial Camp.

It's not yet clear how the battle for the Rusted Wasteland will play out. Either way, we should keep our eyes on the future. And your particular pair is better than anything I've ever seen.

As we all know, Coba Plateau contains four more anomalies. However, they are all located beyond the Cordon and are guarded by the goblin mafia. Even our spies failed all their recon missions to the area. However, that crafty group of Prospectors somehow managed to swindle the mafia into letting them sneak past the Cordon and leave with their bags full of artifacts. Really powerful artifacts, too! The kind that puts the Scorpion Stinger and Magical Poison Gland to shame.

The City Council has decided to assign you the task of penetrating the Prospectors' ranks. Somewhere east of here, at the very center of the Plateau, there's an inn where all the bounty hunters gather. And that includes the Free Traders, who, in spite of international agreements, buy up their artifacts. Our sources tell us that the innkeeper is one Gorislav Gipitsky. Disguise yourself as a defector, one who doesn't mind some danger, as long as that danger nets you your share of gold. The place is always frequented by adventurers, so you shouldn't stick out too much.

Your mission is to find out how to get to the four anomalies from the Prospectors, then travel over there and explore them.
So, did you manage to worm your way into their confidence? Ugh, those Prospectors are such riffraff!
So, four anomalies... Each one more loaded with artifacts than the other. If we capture them before the League does... That's a sure ticket to victory in this war!
Find a way to convince the Free Traders at the Prospectors' Inn to share with you how to reach the 4 Anomalies for the Great Inquisitor in the League camp.

You've already done a great deal for the Church of Light. And when I try to think of who to entrust with the most important task of all, I do not see a better candidate than you.
Beyond the Cordon, which is heavily guarded by the goblin mafia, lie four anomalies. The Dark Artifacts contained therein must be destroyed! The time has come to for us to branch out and go beyond the Cordon.
Our sources tell us that Prospectors, those bounty hunters who no doubt have sold their soul to the darkness, are able to sneak through the Cordon and come back with artifacts. In the center of the plateau is an inn where they gather, unload their illicit goods to the Free Traders, and exchange information. The innkeeper is one Gorislav Gipitsky.
Your mission is as follows - disguise yourself as a defector who wants to join up with their band of criminals... Meaning the group known as the Prospectors... And find the way to the four eastern anomalies.
But be vigilant! You are heading into the den of creatures that are both nefarious and amoral, for which the notions of homeland, duty, or Light are empty words. All they care for is gold covered with blood! That said, I am confident that you will resist all the temptations they throw at you.

This is a holy mission! You'll need to pal around with those Prospector jackals that are the very spawn of darkness. But know that sooner or later - probably sooner - they'll all end up on a burning stake.
You did it! This is great! The Emissaries of Light shall take it!
Visit the leaders of the sentry posts surrounding the Prospectors' Inn and return to Gorislav Gipitsky.

A defector, you say... Looking to make a buck... Well, you've come to the right place! You're not the first I've seen and you damn well won't be the last. Well, make yourself at home, but don't forget that you're our guest! Hah! Seriously though, we're always glad to see a new bold and daring soul, and I want to help you.
However - there is one condition. We have to test your worth to us, don't we? There's a war raging outside and thugs and desperados are on the prowl. As you may already know, wine isn't our only merchandise - oh no, we also swing deals of far greater magnitude.
This is why we've hired sentries. Our Prospectors, especially newcomers like yourself, pay their dues by patrolling the surroundings.
We've set up four sentry posts around the tavern. Take your rounds and make sure everything's quiet so that the inn - our home - isn't in any danger.

You can put your mind and rest and focus on your drink. We've got four sentry posts looking after our peace and your gold. By the way, don't forget that every newcomer must visit all four. That's our tradition.
Ah, now you're a full-fledged Prospector! Welcome to our big, happy family.
Kill 6 Rhinoceros Bulls for the Hardened Family.

Now let's get to the second lesson.

It's very simple. Think of it as a warm-up, hehe...

During his travels, a real prospector often has to tighten their belt. There's nothing to eat! So they have to hunt all sorts of animals. Do you know how to hunt? Let's see.

There are quite a few rhinoceroses in the vicinity of the tavern. Try to deal with six of them and come back to us. If you succeed!
We hope that there are still some rhinos out there. The world is changing so rapidly that nothing's ever sure... especially when we're holed up in this inn and don't even peek outside for days!
Our friends say that you killed some fine beasts! Your bag should be ready in no time!
Find 6 Precious Jewels for the Hardened Family.

Just a bag alone isn't going to be enough when you start gathering artifacts beyond the Cordon. What you need is a good pick! The best picks around are made by kobolds. You can find their caves just to the west of the inn.
The only thing is, the kobolds use the picks on hard stone - so as a result, they grow blunt pretty fast. We have a few of them lying around... But we need something to sharpen them with.
The best way to sharpen a kobold pick is to grind them against the jewels they harvest! If you can get me some of their jewels, we'll sharpen you up a nice pick!
Kobolds aren't particularly dangerous, but there's a war going on so they've taken to marauding instead of working. Just try to find a kobold with a pick nowadays, I dare you!
Oh my, it's been so long since we've held a real kobold jewel in our hands... They're so pretty!
Kill 6 Cave Kobolds for Andrey Stoyanov at the Sentry Post outside the Inn.

Gorislav sent you? Well, things are relatively quiet around here. The inn isn't in any real danger - you can assure Gorislav of that. But as far as the Prospectors go...
Well, kobolds have been acting up a bit. You'd think that the beasts would be dumb as they come, but even they can smell a profit and know how to snatch a slice for themselves. They stay away from the anomalies themselves, but recently, they've been waiting for the Prospectors that are heading back with their loot and then they jump them and steal the artifacts... Those cave-dwelling nasties need to be taught a lesson! But I can't leave my post, no way no how.
I can't imagine who the kobolds sell the artifacts to - I don't know a single Trader willing to deal with them!

So the kobolds now know their place, eh?
You'll have plenty of Prospectors singing your praises for this!
Find and kill the monster that's controlling the kobolds and report back to Andrey Stoyanov.

I'm ashamed to admit that I've become a prisoner of the kobolds! But then, there were twenty of them and I was alone...
Listen to what I got out of their babble. There's some sinister creature hiding somewhere deep in the cave. The kobolds are scared witless of it and obey all of its commands.
So, what does that thing want? Artifacts! The kobolds themselves are a private and hard-working breed and I've got nothing against them. We need to find out what about this creature deep in the cave that's pushing the kobolds to commit these atrocities.
I'd love to help, but my arm is broken. Find out what you can, then report to Andrey Stoyanov about what's happening down here.
What do the kobolds want with artifacts? I mean, they don't trade with anyone. Something's fishy here...
A wormfaced monster is controlling the kobolds? Well, that explains it, though I sure didn't see this coming!
Take the June Artifact to Historian Bertille de Pluie at the Inn.

It's an ancient artifact! Hmm, it's pretty strange, quite unlike most dark artifacts. It's probably the dark artifacts' ancient June counterpart.
We need to show this to a Historian right away.

This is a June artifact, no doubt about it!
You say you got it off an octopus faced monster?... Maybe he brought it with him from the west? Or could it have been lying around the Plateau somewhere?
Take the June Artifact to Sarang Huni in the Historians' Camp in the Meridian Outback.

I know who can help us - Sarang Huni. He once did a report on the strange creatures of Sarnaut and mentioned legends about certain "Wormfaces..." You can find him in the Historians' Camp in the Meridian Outback. Take this artifact to him and tell him everything you saw.
We still remember and discuss the June and Zem people... Perhaps a thousand years from now, other Historians of some other new race will be digging up ancient League and Empire artifacts...
This artifact was discovered on the body of a wormfaced creature?! How curious!
Participate in killing the Shadowy Prospector for the Hardened Family.

You need just one more thing before you can become a proper Prospector... It's a fairly modern device that most Prospectors can't do without nowadays, although we used to work without it, and we did a fine job too!
The Deadman's Eye is a complex device, a fusion of magic and technology, that warns of you any undead in the area. It's a must-have in an anomaly!
Over at the Meridian Outback you'll find a fallen Prospector. His greed has turned him into a shadow, forced to wander the land with no earthly possessions. We're sure his eye would make a powerful Deadman's Eye! Go find him and bring him down, then we'll have our friends carefully extract the eye for you!
We'd really prefer to work without a Deadman's Eye, back like when we were young...
Now you know what it takes to become a proper Prospector! Good luck in all your exploits!

It's good that Gorislav sent you. We've got a real nightmare on our hands... It's those ogres! Those monsters have taken a liking to eating intelligent creatures. And they don't care where they get their meal! They've been known to drag fallen soldiers off the battlefield and attack wandering Prospectors.
How terrible! I can't even visualize it without feeling a burning desire to throw it all away and run. I don't care where, even if it's into the arms of the Imperial Army!
Something must be done! Those cannibals must be dealt with, especially their leader, Boog. I suspect it was him that started up this terrible diet among that clan. As long as I can remember, the ogres have always settled for wolf meat and never complained.

I barely got any sleep last night... I kept imagining those ogres cooking me in their enormous cauldron... Oh, what am I talking about - what cauldrons?! Those monsters are more likely to gobble you up alive! I better start thinking about something else or I'll lose my wits!
What? No more Boog? I can't believe it! Oh, Light, have you at last illumed the Mountain Crag?! Come here, let me give you a kiss!
Find Ignat, Ivan, and Boris somewhere near the Mountain Crag for Anton Pyatkin.

Oh, hey! Hic... So, you're on the run too, huh? Respect!
I can't understand why intelligent creatures are forced... Hic... To kill one another! Just because some bigwigs up top got some sort of fight going?! Well they can kiss my... Hic... Yasker and Aidenus, both of 'em! Let's drink! I need more drinks... I'm depressed...
You see, there was four of us that ran away... Me, Ignat, Ivan, and... what the heck was his name... Boris! And yet here I am, drinking alone. Why? 'Cause they've gone missing! Where? I dunno where... Along the way somewhere... And what if they got killed?! Tell me, what if they got killed?! Hic... We wanted to go beyond the Cordon together... Now what?
Say, why ain't you drinking? Don't wanna? Smart choice! Respect!
Say, since you ain't drinking, won't you help me out? Find my friends and I'll make it worth your style... I mean... your while! Hic...
Yes, my friends are missing and I'm here boozing... You can't imagine how scary it was out there, hic...

What is this? A badge? It looks like it belonged to Boris. He was... eaten...? Oh, almighty Light! And the wolves got Ivan? Well, what about Ignat? He's alive? Oh joy! Alright, he and I will go beyond the Cordon together when he comes back. Thank you! What would I do without you! I'd buy you a round, but I'm afraid my gold is gone.
Warn Gorislav Gipitsky, the innkeeper, about the bandit threat.

My buddies and I defected from the Imperial camp. We made it all the way over here only to find bandits and ogres. So, we decided that it would be best to split up... I went to the bandits and pretended to be one of their own, but when I heard what they were planning...
Listen, we need to warn Gorislav that Emelian Razin is planning an attack on the inn!
He's going to slaughter everyone and keep the inn for himself! I heard it with my own ears!
Don't worry about me, I'll get outta here on my own. Just hurry over to the inn! If Razin is successful, this will be the end of free trade as we know it!

What's up? Is something wrong? Emelian... he's planning an attack on the inn? I can't believe it... I can't even recall how many years he's been sitting at this very table... Sometimes even drank on the house. And this is how he repays my generosity?
Backstabbing scoundrel! Oh, how the lust for power changes people!
Kill 6 Goblin Wolfkeepers and report back to Pip the Rowdy.

Oh, and another thing - when I was out beyond the Cordon, I overheard that goblin wolfkeepers train their wolves right under our noses. It's true! They're just to the west. You could probably see them from here!
I'm thinking that it makes sense to bump 'em off while they're still right here, roaming around our area, without all their mafia entourage.

Maybe we should try to domesticate wolves too?
Eh, nah, that's a lousy idea, no one will want to deal with that... All people care about is artifacts. Still, I'd like to know how the goblins manage it.
They're weak and everyone looks down on them, but then they go and pull this...
I just need to recuperate a bit and I'll be on my way - back to the Cordon. I'm ready to write off my last sally as a loss!
Deliver Tonkov's Report to Yawp the Forester at the Northern Border.

Ugh, everything hurts... That Xadaganian skunk beat me from blue to black! I know why Emelian Razin went rabid on me - he doesn't like my prices! But what can I do about it? I'm just following Yawp's orders!
Oh, dear Astral! I'm late with my monthly report! Listen, friend, will you help me? Yawp's trading post is on the Northern Border, near the Astral shore. Please, deliver this report to him!
Tonkov's report? Finally! Hand it over!

He's late... Real late. All the others came in over a week ago!
He's flirting with a hefty fine, that one.
Kill 6 Red Band Bandits and report back to Zubo the Wily.

Ugh, what the heck just happened?! Prospectors wearing Red Bands around their arms attacked the post! I'm really confused... I work for Gorislav and it's my job to protect the Prospectors. So, what gives? I had to just stand here and take that beating!
Oh... the guys with the Red Bands are criminals... Well, why didn't anybody warn me?! Had I known it ahead of time, I would've given them a real good thrasing! Hey, um... Maybe you can help me? I can't handle them on my own now, given my condition.
The Red Band camp is nearby. We better reinforce the post or give the bandits a good dusting -you know, bring 'em down to earth. That'll work too.
The less Red Band hoodlums to worry about, the better. Well done!
Kill Emelian Razin and bring Emelian Razin's Head to Gorislav Gipitsky.

So Emelian's got his sights on the inn, huh? Now that makes me really angry! I guess that means I'll just have to put a price on his head! Listen up, boys! We've suffered much, aye, but we won't allow one turncoat to screw us out of our freedom!
Whoever brings me Emelian's head will be getting a fat reward! Yes, his head - you heard me! We're not in the sandbox anymore, kids! If you slip up, be prepared to pay a hefty price!
Emelian Razin, a leader? Hah! This inn is a zone for free creatures! We didn't come here just to snuggle up under somebody else's foot. We won't stand for it!
Emelian, you fool... You had such promise, why did you have to go and screw things up for yourself? In the end, it cost you your head...
Put on the Bandit Mask and rob the wagon train on the Northern Border. Return and share the loot with Aimee de Doucer at the Inn.

Say, can I trust you? Hmm... I guess I can, you have an honest face... I'm new here, kind of like you. I escaped from Brazen Hill. I was being persecuted endlessly back in Kania due to my family's fall from grace. Then they had those rookies from Umoira giving me all kinds of crap, so I escaped.
I heard you could make a killing selling artifacts at the Inn. Hogwash! I spent a week toiling in the Rusted Wasteland, then I get back here and could hardly sell them! The only things valued around here are trinkets from beyond the Cordon. Which means that I'm still broke...
To top it all off, care to venture a guess as to how much the Traders want for a bag and a pick so I can do proper prospecting? An arm and a leg!
I've got this idea, but I'll need some help. I overheard an interesting tidbit earlier - a wagon train is headed to the post on the Northern Border with artifacts from beyond the Cordon. Why don't the two of us rob it?! This'll solve all our problems!
Don't get nervous, it really is a safe bet. I'll tell you exactly where to set up the ambush - just don't forget about my share! So, how about it?

And don't you dare try to con me! If I find out that the train was robbed and I don't have my share...
I'll turn you in to Gorislav in a flash!

That's my share! I shouldn't have doubted you!
We Prospectors are all brothers! Well, sisters too, hehe! And don't fret about swindling those Traders - it's us that risk our lives day and night, while those moneybags get rich off our sweat!
Kill 6 Savage Tigers and report to Peter Jakov.

Peter Jakov at your service! Are you from Igsh by any chance? Looking to purchase some horses? No? That's too bad. Coba Plateau is home to the finest horses in Sarnaut.
My people and I catch them and train them. All the local herds either belong to me already or will belong to me in the near future.
Listen, if you're not going to be buying horses, how about you do a job for me? The tigers have become a nuisance. My horses can't seem to get a moment to graze on their pastures in peace... You're not afraid of tiger fangs, are you? Good to hear it! Now get going!
The more people I meet, the more I like horses. There's only one good thing about people - they have gold!
Thanks so much! Now that my horses are safe my business is sure to succeed.
Brand 6 Wild Stallions and report back to Peter Jade.

I've got the perfect job for a real warrior who is agile and, most importantly, fleet of foot. It's that time again! It's time to brand horses! Everyone around here needs to know that these steeds are Peter Jakov's property!
Unfortunately, my workers refuse to do it. The horses remember their life of freedom all too vividly... that and they don't seem to fancy a scalding brand burned into their backside. That's where fleetness of foot comes in!
Hey, don't leave! This is why I pay big money to whoever gets the job done! Oh, and don't forget to keep checking to make sure that the brand doesn't cool. So, will you do it?
The lad I hired before you got a hoof to the ear from this one Steed... On the bright side, he's probably already back home in the Empire, collecting his veteran's pension.
You've done it! Now nobody will dare set their sights on my horses!
Speak with the Tussling Family about getting through the Cordon.

Since you brought the report, I'd guess that you're a Prospector too. But it's no big deal if you aren't... just as long as you're not a goblin!
To the east of here is a gorge that splits Coba Plateau in two. That's the Cordon. Past it you'll find four anomalies that are full of valuable artifacts, goblin weapons, and, unfortunately, mafia enforcers.
The mafia protects the Cordon at all times. There are some bridges stretched over the gorge, but they're all under mafia control too. So, how do Prospectors manage to get through the Cordon? They've yet to grow wings, to my knowledge!
We'll never stop trying to get to the other side. Our boys are trying to capture the northern bridge as we speak. If you want to help the Traders and make it past the Cordon - it's not likely, but hey, you might get lucky - then hurry over to the Tussling Family. They're the Gibberlings that are heading up the attack.
Hold it! Where do you think you're going? To help? Hah! It's so convenient that you guys are real eager to help... After we've already taken the bridge!
Speak with Thibault de Desirae in the Historians' Camp in the Meridian Outback.

What are the Historians are doing in Coba Plateau? Then you must not know how many Zem ruins there are in this place!
We're studying them and piecing together a picture of the past. A picture that shows the fall of Tep! It's all very interesting, you see. Oh yeah, we're also hiring Prospectors!
But things have been kind of slow. Not only is there a war raging, but we're also contending with an inaccessible Cordon and this mafia... It's very difficult to conduct research under such conditions!
So listen, I've got an important job that needs to be done... Hmm, never mind, you're a little too green for a Prospector. Don't take it personally! It's just that the task is very dangerous and I cannot entrust it to someone who has never laid eyes on the Artifacts of Power. Yes, that's what it's about, the artifacts beyond the Cordon!
How about you head out to the Meridian Outback instead. That's where my colleagues have set up camp. They need plenty of help as well.

Everyone's lost their mind hunting for these Dark Artifacts!
I mean, what are these poor souls really looking for? To get a little bit stronger, to weaken their opponent... It's all vanity! They can't see beyond their own noses! When the Great Cataclysm strikes again, where will the League and the Empire be?
That's what I thought! We have no clue what sort of volcano we're living on and when the monster is going to burst! All we know how to do is to spill blood and hunt for gold.
The only real treasure on this allod is the artifacts of the June and Zem people. They contain the greatest prize of all - knowledge! Though, to you Prospectors, they're nothing but cheap and decrepit trash.
At least you're willing to be bought. The Historians can't be bothered with the likes of the mafia or this war business. That is why we need your assistance.
Kill 6 Goblin Spies and report back to Percival de Ardeur.

Huh? What? Who are you? Oh, sorry, I must have dozed off there for a second... It's so quiet and peaceful down here. Tell Gorislav not to worry so much. Although, there is one thing... the Prospectors have complained about seeing some goblins at the Savage Steppe.
The witnesses said they weren't attacking or anything. Instead they were moving around quietly, trying to keep hidden. Clearly they weren't warriors but spies. I can't imagine what they're looking for down here, but that's no reason to keep them alive, now is it?
I don't know, I didn't see any spies... Maybe those Prospectors were wrong...
So there were spies! Although, thanks to you they're no longer there! Praise the Light! Now I can get back to sleep.
Recover 4 crates with the belongings that were stolen by the Pirates and return to the Historians.

Our biggest headache at the moment is those pirates.
As soon as they got the whiff of easy profit, they hightailed it right to Coba Plateau. But instead of trying to get through the Cordon, they attacked us defenseless Historians. Those fools! Did they expect to find the Artifacts of Power in our crates?!
The stuff they stole is of no value to them, but for us... They've got our equipment, records, and books!
Our work has come to a complete halt! Help us recover our property! The pirates are anchored at a bay just south of here. You'll have no problem finding them.
I'm worried that those barbarians will start throwing our stuff into the Astral! Please, hurry!
Oh, our equipment, our books... All intact and operational! Thank you so, so much!
Collect 4 Sturdy Ropes from the Pirates for inventor Leonard de Vevre at the Historians' Camp.

Let's see... A tweak here, a little tweak there... Where's my chart? Oh, here it is... So...
The touchdown aim point comes out to... Right here... Down the center of the gorge... Hmm, that won't work... Huh? What? Get outta here, don't bother me! Can't you see I'm thinking! What if we tighten this here... Yes! Tighten it here - that's it!
Oh, hey Prospector, it's good that you're here. I need a few strong ropes for this catapult ASAP! Do you have any on you by any chance? What?! You don't carry a coil of rope on you at all times?! That's just weird... Hmm, so what do we do now?
Oh, of course! The pirates on the bay! They will have some ropes to spare for sure! Go on over there and bring me back some!
Well, why are you still here? Do you want to get beyond the Cordon or not? Yes? Then go get those ropes! Move it!
The lake... we must hit the lake! And only sturdy ropes can provide the pull we need.

That's it, keep going... Just a little bit more... Now all that's left for us to do is to aim!
Help me do this one last thing real fast. When I repair the catapult, you can use it anytime you like!
Kill 6 Pirate Fighters and Crowbar the Bloodthirsty, then report back to Dmitry Obukhov.

The Historians say that they've seen wolves not far from here. Some even claim to have spotted goblins. All of these are trivial complaints - the real threat is this pirate attack!
Now, we're all veterans who've seen our fair share of action, right? We can't just leave these bookworms completely unaided. And what if that Gerodot fella is speaking the truth... What if he digs up valuable info on a new Cataclysm...
So, let's do this - I'll comb the area for goblins, while you head to the bay and teach those pirates a lesson they won't soon forget. Deal?
You know, I didn't see a single goblin out there. How did it go with the pirates?
Good! Those treacherous pirates got what was coming to them! We won't be seeing them again anytime soon!
Take the Admiral's letter to Gorislav Gipitsky, the Innkeeper at the Prospectors' Inn.

It's a letter, addressed to the innkeeper. I hear he's a native to Gipat. Hmm, that's a familiar name.
They seem to be demanding a huge sum of money, otherwise they'll...
The page cut's off after that. A strange find, but we better get this to Gorislav.
What? This is the best news I've heard in a long time!

Don't you see?! It's Veronika! She's alive! I'm sure it's about her, I just know it!
We went on a trip not too long ago and our ship was attacked by pirates. They stole many things – gold and supplies... But worst of all, they stole my darling, my beautiful, beloved daughter, Veronika, the apple of my eye!
I had lost hope of ever seeing her again... I... I... But she's alive! They want to return her to me! And all they want is gold!
Gold... But I don't have that much gold... Even if I sell the inn I still won't have enough! Oh no, what am I going to do?!
Find 5 Zem Dolls for Gorislav Gipitsky.

There's only one way to raise that much money, only one - and that's with Zem Dolls.
They're the rarest artifacts throughout the Plateau. I've been here longer than most and I've only ever seen one. It took the Traders several days to scrape up enough money to buy it off the Prospector, who then wrapped up his affairs in a matter of hours and took off for Novograd with plans of buying a house and settling down.
The dolls themselves are plain and kind of scary looking... Historians claim that Zem children used to play with them. The bones of those children have long since been reduced to ashes, but their dolls are now worth more than their weight in gold. If I could come by some of those dolls, I'd be able to ransom my darling daughter...
I dare not ask for your free help in the matter. I only ask that you look upon a father that's mad with grief and ready to sacrifice all he has. I don't have anything to pay you with, as all I own will go toward the ransom money. However, I do have information - conversations between Prospectors, Historians, Free Traders... I also have information on Gipat - a lost allod that holds ancient secrets! Sometimes information is worth more than money, much more... Please help me!

The pirate captain died before he could give me the ransom letter, but I'm sure that one of his people will still show up before long! Now more than ever the pirates are in need of gold. Help me! Help me get back my daughter!
Your heart is bursting with kindness and courage. It's incredible! Except... Something has happened...

Take the readings of the three Detectors in the anomalies at the Giant's Table, the Barren Boneyard, and Husk Isle, and then take them to Pascal de Vevre, leader of the Hunter expedition, at his camp.

I was told that I could trust you... At least I think it was you. The free trade mercenaries said that you helped to break through the Cordon, right?
Maybe you've already heard of the demons that were spotted on Asee-Teph and Eljune? Demons are still a matter of myth in these parts, but it's only a matter of time until people see what's going on. The artifacts that everyone loves to collect emit darkness, and that is sure to have attracted some demons.
That's why a hunting expedition has come to the Holy Land. We made camp outside of Husk Isle, near one of the anomalies, and set demon detectors in the other three. The detectors are magical devices created by Zem masters from before the Great Astral Campaign, when the whole world was battling those wretches. Nowadays, we're the only ones who still use them, since everybody thinks that demons are a thing of the past. Personally, I don't know about that...
Pascal, the leader of our expedition, has sent me to go take the readings... But I can't leave the inn at the moment - a Hunter named Alexey Luzhin sends word of a demon encounter in the Tekyan Thicket of Asee-Teph. A very strange demon, too, one that could survive outside the Astral for a long period of time! Alexey thinks the beast was a new breed of demon and if that's true... Well, then this is very alarming news. I must stay here and wait for Fielder's return. But at the same time, Pascal is awaiting my return.
This is where I ask you for help. If you plan on traveling beyond the Cordon, could you please find the three detectors, take their readings, and bring them to Pascal's camp outside of Husk Isle.
I hope that you don't bear any silly prejudice against us and that you will agree to lend a helping hand.
Who are you? What do you want?

Detector readings? I've been waiting on those for quite some time now.
What's wrong with Anastasia? Is she still alive?

Detector readings? I've been waiting on those for quite some time now.
What's wrong with Anastasia? Is she still alive?
Collect 6 Black Marks, Heavy Shackles, Strange Bandages, and Tainted Eyes for Andrey Tonkov.

I heard that you managed to get beyond the Cordon. Well, that means you're a real Prospector now!
And that means you can join us on the great hunt for artifacts. Prospectors have been bringing less and less as of late. But my obligations for the Traders are still the same and if my turnover keeps taking hits, they may run me out of the inn. And this is the cushiest gig on the entire Plateau!
I've got a business proposition for you – if you start collecting artifacts and selling them to me, and only me, I'll slash my prices for you in return. Deal?
I'm especially interested in unique items, such as the Black Mark, Heavy Shackles, Strange Bandage, and Tainted Eye. Those are the top on my wish list.
Ugh, I really don't want to lose my spot at Prospectors' Inn...
Thank you. You can count on being pleasantly surprised by my prices from here on out.
Collect Yawp the Forester's debt money from Vladimir Shiporov, the Kiddy Family, Nomarkh Semenkare and the mysterious debtor, and kill Nomarkh Semenkare.

You've been beyond the Cordon, so you're a Prospector now. It's time that we promote our business relationship!
One of my main sources of income is lending gold to rookie Prospectors. Most repay their loans with interest and keep thanking good ol' Yawp till the end of their days for helping them get their business off the ground.
But then there are those who just hit it, leaving me wondering whether my debtors are stuck in some ditch, or their souls're on the way to their final abode, or I simply got scammed.
Now, my list of debtors has grown rather long. If you find any of these skunks in your travels, try and collect my money from them. I'll give you a nice reward if you do.
Here are some names on my list. A Xadaganian named Vladimir Shiporov... To be honest, I don't even remember him - I just have his name put down here.
The Kiddy Family... Their bones must long be six feet under.
There's this other debtor... I can't make out his name, but I recall him saying that he was heading towards Giant's Table.
Most importantly, there's an Arisen named Nomarkh Semenkare who owes me money! I wish this bastard had never risen from his grave in the first place! He robbed me! Your task is not only to retrieve what he has stolen, but to kick his soul back to hell! Do this and I'll make sure that you're very satisfied with your reward!
Did you find my debtors? Your reward is still waiting for you.
You did it! I'm speechless! I had already written all that money off as losses! It's good to know that Nomarkh Semenkare won't be around to scam people anymore, too.
Find 4 Zem Manuscripts in the anomalies beyond the Cordon for Thibault de Desirae at the Historians' Camp.

Those pirates have cost us so much time! We're just sitting here while the Prospectors and the mafia goons are scouring the ruins as we speak! I shudder to imagine someone's careless boot stepping on and breaking some fragile historical document! Ugh, I don't even want to think about it!
We know that the Zem people were big bureaucrats and recorded on paper or carved onto tablets every little fact. Everything from the number of cows a bride got as her dowry to complex astronomical observations. Our first order of business is to search the ruins for ancient manuscripts. And please, hurry!

There are Zem ruins beyond the Cordon where Historians have never set foot before! Who knows what kind of treasures they hide.
They may even contain ancient manuscripts...

Careful! I said watch it! These are ancient manuscripts... And in mint condition to boot. It's obvious that the ruin had only been discovered recently. It will take some time to translate all this and even more time to understand it.
Find 4 Ancient Artifacts in the anomalies beyond the Cordon for Historian Bertille de Pluie at the Inn.

Coba Plateau is a very interesting place. This is where Tep battled the great Zem mages that, unfortunately, ended in a draw. The Zem died out and Tep then came down with his own plague. That's when his wondrous Pyramid became his grave. After the Great Cataclysm, it was Tep's magical powers that sustained Sarnaut in its current state. That is, until Tensess' Soul replaced him. Unnamed, virtually unknown and inhabited by wild forestfolk, this area was left to rot for hundreds of years.
Many of its secrets have yet to be revealed. We've studied the Rusted Wasteland very thoroughly, but there's no end to the amount of work in store for us at the Zem ruins to the east. Our quandary is this - how do humble servants of history like us even get there, when the mafia practically runs the Cordon? This is why we need brave individuals like you to risk their lives for the sake of the ultimate truth!
What does the mission entail? Basically, just keep your eyes open when you prowl the ruins. And I have no doubt that you'll be doing your fair share of prowling. Bring me any valuable historical artifacts that you find in anomalies beyond the Cordon.
Did you find anything interesting in the Zem ruins?
Whoa, that's a lot of stuff! Hold on a minute, I need some time to study this.
Promise Bertille de Pluie that uncovering the secrets of the past will not become less important than helping the Empire.

It would be great if you'd agree to help us Historians. Here on Coba Plateau many people only think about profit and those terrible Dark Artifacts. I'm desperate to find someone who'll explore the ancient Zem ruins without a hefty reward.
One more thing - I've recently heard some strange rumors about a quarrel between the Historians and the League and the Empire. I have no idea what they're talking about so don't bother asking me for information.
Now, before we begin our work together I want you to make me a promise. Swear that you will search for the truth, and that you will take this task as seriously as your obligations to the Empire. I don't want to waste time with a partner that leaves in the middle of a job. Well, what do you say?
Excellent! Now that we understand each other we can begin our research. Believe me when I say that a lot needs to be done.
Promise Bertille de Pluie that uncovering the secrets of the past will not become less important than helping the League.

Excellent! Now that we understand each other we can begin our research. Believe me when I say that a lot needs to be done.
Kill 6 Goblin Wolfkeepers or 6 Wolf Guards for the Tussling Family.

Wait, don't go! We like you. You have a pinch of lunacy in you! If you team up with us, we'll be pulling pranks all throughout the night!
We've got a bold plan to take control of the central bridge. Are you still with us? From there, we're just one small hop away from entering their lair! The central bridge is heavily guarded, so the goblins won't expect an attack.
They're probably just sittin' around, playing cards... And then, all of a sudden, we crash the party! No, not head on! We're not stupid! First, we'll sneak up to the bridge from the other side of the Cordon and then we'll waste the goblin guards and their pet wolves. That's something they definitely won't expect!
First, we'll capture the central bridge. Then we'll weigh our options and see about making a move straight for the mafia's lair... Ooh, we can't wait!
Did you do it? Were you really quiet? Excellent!
Add the Grass Potion to 3 Goblins' Cauldrons. Report back to the Tussling Family.

See that elevation to the east? That's where one of the anomalies is. It's called the Giant's Table. Do you want to know the meaning behind the name?
You see, there is strange magic in the area that can blow you up to fantastic dimensions or shrink you down to the size of a pea. Both scenarios have certain advantages and disadvantages.
If you're tiny, you can run around the area and collect artifacts to your heart's content. No one will ever be able to see you... but you're as weak as they come. If somebody steps on you... well, you're a goner. But if you're gigantic, then everybody wants a piece of you... even if you've become much tougher to handle.
That's just a small taste of the wonders at the Giant's Table. But there's also tons of mundane threats... such as goblins.
There's a sentry post out at the Giant's Table and the goblins there are the nastiest you'll ever meet! Prospectors keep complaining and asking us to teach those goblins a lesson. That's why we came up with a plan in the true Gibberling fashion - sneaky, crafty, and subtle.
Take this. It's an herbal poison. Your objective is to sneak into the post and pour the poison into their cauldrons. This little spice will give those goblins a terrible stomach ache! So, do you think you can handle the task?
"When blades prove powerless, turn to poison." We read that somewhere, didn't we, brothers?
Is the poison in the cauldrons? Ooh, what we wouldn't give to sneak a peek of that goblin feast tonight!
Kill the Lucky Family and bring their amulet to Sergey Ryskin.

You're going to the Giant's Table? You'll just be wasting your time. I'm sure the Lucky Family has already gotten their paws on whatever valuables there were.
What? You don't know who the Lucky Family? Have you been living under a rock or something? Hah! They're a family of Gibberling Prospectors. Whatever they go they always emerge with bags full of artifacts and without so much as a scratch! They even have all the Traders buying up their goods at special prices.
I'm telling you, there's something fishy about them. I suspect that their luck is nothing but a facade! Yes, I'm willing to bet that they blindside unsuspecting Prospectors and clean out their bags! There's just no way that any living creature can be this lucky! Even if there are three of them!
I propose that we gut these sly bastards! Trust me, no one likes them around here - they just make everybody nervous. You can even keep all their artifacts! I only ask that you bring me their amulet just so I know that they're really dead.
Just you watch, as soon as the Lucky Family is gone all the honest Prospectors will see a surge in their business!

And here's the amulet. Wait a second, it's magic... It's a warding spell that scares off undead... So that's the Lucky Family's secret! The undead never bothered them!
Why are you looking at me like that? So, they never attacked the other Prospectors after all. I made a mistake, big deal! I still got a nice amulet out of this, so thanks a bunch!
Bring 6 Snake Skins to Zenka the Nimble.

You managed to cross the Barren Boneyard? Congratulations! It's not easy to survive in this place, I know. Every step feels like you've got a twenty pound weight taped to each ankle...
Would you like to help me out? I'll give you something useful in return. A speed potion. Three of them! Can come in handy in a tight situation.
I need snake skins. Six pieces. I want to make a tough, durable waterskin. Because I'm always thirsty around here.
Bring me snake skins - I'll keep my end of the bargain.
What? What do you mean you can't find any? There are plenty of cobras just to the south of here.
...And here is your potion. See, we Prospectors need to look out for one another!
Kill 6 Goblin Prospectors for the Stalwart Family.

As if we didn't have enough to worry about with the undead, now we've got some of the mafia's workers raiding the Barren Boneyard as well. We're forced to wait our here until they wrap up and leave. Although...
If we don't do anything, they'll snatch up all the artifacts for sure. So why are we sitting here? We're Prospectors, right? Let's go take the fight to the goblins! If you help us take some of them down we'll give you a nice reward!
Did you deal with the mafia?
I told you that dealing with those guys would be piece of cake. They're only goblins, after all! Now let's hurry to the anomalies. Come on, get up and get your bags!
Find and return Vladimir Shiporov's bag in the Barren Boneyard.

Aye, I owe that money, I'm not denying it. And I was about to repay it, but then I was attacked by skeletons! A whole mess of them. I had no choice but to flee.
Unfortunately, I lost my bag when I ran. There were plenty of artifacts in there. Really. It's somewhere in the Barren Boneyard. If I could find it, I'd repay the debt right away!
The bag was the last thing on my mind. Hell, I barely escaped with my life! I thought I was a goner for sure...

My bag! Here, take this - the money's inside. And tell Yawp that I was going to pay it back. I don't forget my debts. It's just that I was attacked and that slowed me down. Don't forget to tell him that, okay?
Find Prospector Alain de Ardeur in the Spectral Gorge for Sarang Huni.

We ran into a strange wormfaced creature as well. Well, not in person, fortunately. A Prospector we hired, Alain de Ardeur, came upon one in the Spectral Gorge - an anomaly located northeast of here. It's an awful place, a genuine tomb! But let's get back to wormface.
I'm not sure if it's the same creature, but we'll know the answer to that soon enough. Well, maybe not that soon... You see, Adam has disappeared!
We sent him back to the ruins, this time with a Desorotype. That's a unique device, very expensive. Whatever your eyes see, that's what it photographs on this here sheet. Do you understand?
But it's been three days now and Adam still hasn't returned with the Desorotype. We're very concerned. We don't want to suspect him of cheating us and escaping with the device... But you Prospectors are such fickle creatures... Hmm, I'm sorry, I didn't mean you.
Please, try to find Adam for us in the Gorge.

Yep, I'm here on a mission from the Historians. Unfortunately, these Tep cultists appeared in the ruins out of the blue and disrupted my research.
No, I don't have the Desorotype on me. I'm willing to bet that it's the only thing keeping me alive right now.
Take the Desorotype from Adam's bag, find the fresco painting of the Wormface in the Tep Ruin, photograph it, and return to Sarang Huni.

I should probably be focused on saving my own life. But if you want to help the Historians, you can check the cultists for my things. I doubt those barbarians have any clue as to the true value of desorotype!
The fresco of the wormface that captured the Historians' interest can be found in those far ruins. Best of luck!
Oh, wait! One more thing... The Historians might find this detail interesting as well. The cultists mentioned that these ruins are sacred to them for being the site of Tep's grandiose battle with the Zem mages. Be sure to tell them that.
I am so happy to see you! Were you able to find Adam? I was so worried. So much time has passed that I had hired two more Prospectors. One to look for him and one to look for you.

And that's the wormface... This desorotype really is quite the wonder! Anyhow, let's see here...
Does he look like your monster? It's him, isn't it? I thought so! Judging by the style with which the fresco was done, I'd say it's older than the Great Cataclysm. All signs point to our wormface being an ancient creature, rather than some freak result of the anomaly's magic. We must send an immediate inquiry to the Historian Collegiums!
Kill 6 Tep Servants and their leader, Nomarkh Semenkare, and report to Gorislav Gipitsky.

He lied to me! Nomarkh Semenkare... He worships Tep! We were friends, he and I. He arrived from Igsh - a diligent and enthusiastic Prospector that didn't want to leave even an inch of the allod unexplored. I suppose I should've noticed those oddities as well.
Take his title, for instance - Nomarkh... I often asked myself why an Arisen of such high standing would suddenly decide to become a Prospector.
More often than not, the job is dirty and dangerous... He never explained the answer. Instead, he just shut everyone out. I didn't think anything of it - we, the Arisen, carry heavy mental burdens, every last one of us.
And then it all came out! He's no Prospector, he's the cultists' leader! The reason he came here was to scout out the scene and make preparations for their arrival!
He didn't even remember our friendship, how we shared everything we had, down to a ragged blanket at night. He threw me in this cage and promised me a quick death.
He's mad! Please, stop those cultists if you can. Oh, and be sure to warn Gorislav at the Inn about this new danger! Tell him that although Seku and I always went everywhere together, I'm no cultist! No, no!
Do you have any news to share?
What? Tep cultists in the gorge? As if we didn't have enough to worry about! Yes, yes, of course, I'll tell you everything we know.
Rob the Mafia's Transshipment Point to help the Kiddy Family pay off their debt to Yawp the Forester.

Who sent you? Yawp the Forester?
But we're no longer Prospectors! We met the Demon Hunters and right away we knew our true purpose in life! Providence has guided us beyond the Cordon. Yes, of course we still remember our debt to him... And this memory is a burden, for sure... Bill even has trouble sleeping over it. But what can we do? We weren't able to find anything of value, we simply wasted someone else's gold. We're very ashamed, yes, very ashamed...
Wipe those tears, Bill! Let's brainstorm!
Listen, what if we tell you that we saw some filthy goblins packing some very valuable artifacts in a crate to take to their transshipment point near Blackjack's Bid?
And that if you get that crate, there'll be enough gold both for you and us to settle our debt to Yaw?? Oh, please say yes! Pretty please!
What's Blackjack's Bid? Whoa, you really are new here. Blackjack is the main goblin, head of the entire mafia! And his headquarters is their camp. Now that's a place with more artifacts than there are stars in the sky...
We were sneaking by one night and saw the goblins packing away valuable artifacts. But who are we to attack the goblin warriors...

The crate! You got it! Take these artifacts, they will cover our debt. Hmm, there's also a strange doll in here... We've never seen one like it before. You can take it too. We're grownups now - we don't play with dolls anymore! Right, Bill? Bill? Bill, hand over that doll right this instant!

This turned out to be a terrible spot for a camp... The entire night we were forced to listen to a high-pitched howl. Over and over again... It really makes your skin crawl. We even dubbed whoever's doing it Nighthowl.
When dawn broke, I decided to seek out the source of that terrible cry. And do you know what I found? A skeleton! Just standing there, howling at top of its lungs, like he's tormented by something. I kind of doubt that a skeleton like that can have any sort of emotional anguish... Still, if you can help rid us of it, we'd be extremely grateful.
There's that howl again! Or... maybe the howl is just ringing in my ears?
The howling skeleton is gone? Praise the Light! I feel like howling myself - but from joy!
Take the letter outlining Blackjack's orders to the Commissioner, Semer Kiya, in the Imperial Camp.

The goblins found buyers for the artifacts! But who is this mysterious buyer? The League? Empire? Who else could it be?
The Dark Artifacts are fraught with evil. We can't let them fall further into the wrong hands! Maybe it's time we let the City Council deal with this... I believe this letter may be of interest to your Commissioner Semer Kiya.
Here, take it to her. Let her figure it out.
What? Is there any important news?
It's the League! Those vile demons! How were they able to conduct this deal right under our noses? Great Nezeb!
Take the letter outlining Blackjack's orders to the Grand Inquisitor, Afanasy Firov, in the League Camp.

The goblins found buyers for the artifacts! But who is this mysterious buyer? The League? Empire? Who else could it be?
The Dark Artifacts are fraught with evil. We can't let them fall further into the wrong hands! I think it's time that we take this to a higher power... And I think this letter will interest clergy.
Here, take it to the inquisitor, Afanasy Firov in the League camp on Brazen Hill. Let them deal with it.
All the artifacts have been sold... Oh, Holy Light, do not leave us! Who else but the Empire could be this buyer?
Sneak into the Goblin Camp and find the reason as to why they're acting to strangely and report on it to Pascal de Vevre at the Demon Hunter's Camp.

The goblins have been acting strange lately...
They're being more secretive than usual and speaking in hushed tones. I don't like it. They're up to something, I just know it!
I want you to go sneak into their camp to the north of here and see if you can find something. Maybe one of them has something that can clue us into what's going on. Then report to Pascal on whatever you find.
What? Goblins are leaving the Holy Land? Let me see that order!

"An urgent order for all Goblins to leave the Holy Land... The sale of all the artifacts to the customer has been completed... Whoever doesn't make it out in time, it's your own damn fault..."
All the artifacts have been sold...? This is horrible! Who could this customer be?!
Sneak into the Goblin Camp and find the reason as to why they're acting to strangely and report on it to Pascal de Vevre at the Demon Hunter's Camp.

The goblins have been acting strange lately...
They're being more secretive than usual and speaking in hushed tones. I don't like it. They're up to something, I just know it!
I want you to go sneak into their camp to the north of here and see if you can find something. Maybe one of them has something that can clue us into what's going on. Then report to Pascal on whatever you find.
What? Goblins are leaving the Holy Land? Let me see that order!

"An urgent order for all Goblins to leave the Holy Land... The sale of all the artifacts to the customer has been completed... Whoever doesn't make it out in time, it's your own damn fault..."
All the artifacts have been sold...? This is horrible! Who could this customer be?!
Take Veronika's ransom money to Goy the Silver-Tongued.

I never would have dreamed of meeting a Prospector that would take my sorrow to heart and risk everything to find some Zem Dolls for me... Believe me when I say that my own heart is overflowing with the most sincere gratitude...
Unfortunately, the situation has become even worse lately! The kidnapper came to me while you were gone, and he wasn't even a pirate - he was a goblin!
Turns out, the mafia bought Veronika from the pirates and their asking price is now... everything! My artifacts, my gold, even my inn! I've gathered up everything, it's all here - including the deed to the Prospectors' Inn...
I don't know where the Prospectors and Traders will meet to conduct their business from now on, but I know is that I can't go on like this anymore - all I want is to hold my beloved daughter in my arms again!
Please, take this bag and hurry over to Blackjack's Bid. Hand it over to Goy the Silver-Tongued, the goblin negotiator. I'll be waiting for you here...
We gonna kill the girl or what? We're gettin' bored ova here! Oh, you brought the ransom money?
Lemme check that it's all here... And the deed? Ah, there it is! Alright, take the girl!
Tell Gorislav Gipitsky that his daughter is safe.

I understand that it's you that I owe for my salvation? Thank you, of course. But I could have sorted it out myself! Daddy got over zealous and now we're left with nothing!
Have you heard of Gipat? Oh, of course you have! You know, the girls that fly into the Astral... We'll enter the cave of a dragon and not even frown! Being captured by a pirate is no big deal!
Don't bother trying to accompany me back to the Inn. I'm a big girl. And don't forget to drop by and see Daddy! He must want to thank you.

Hey, there you are! Glad to see you!
Klavdia is already home, safe and sound. I want to reward you for your help...
You saved my poor, little daughter! She's so helpless...
Kill 6 Goblin Guards and Yar the Witch Doctor for Yawp the Forester.

I've asked many to find my debtors, but you're the only one to actually have got the job done. That's why I've come to you with another important task.
I need someone to finally give the goblin mafia a good spanking! I'm prepared to pay well for it. They've had their foot at our throat long enough! We're not just trading here anymore, we're at war!The Holy Land has tons of good relics and countless gold to be made, but what do we have? A bunch of junk that no one wants to buy! Why does the mafia want to make it even harder on us?
I want their shaman dead! That's the rascal responsible for training the wolves and domesticating the vultures. He's made artifact hunting much more difficult which led to such high prices. You may consider Yar the Witch Doctor my sworn enemy!
Whenever I see lightning in the sky, I dream of it coming down and striking Yar right in the face!

That Yar sure was a thorn in my side... You, on the other hand, are a fine specimen! Your service has been invaluable! ...I'm just kidding, everything in this world has a price. Here, take this reward.
Visit Blackjack's Bid and force the engineer, Sarang Petosiris, to talk about his past.

My theory of the close relationship between the June and the Zem is finding new confirmations! June artifacts are sometimes found in the local ruins. The Tep's Sermon, which was found in a cultist's possession, mentions that Tep, at the time of his research into Sparks, based his theories on certain lost magical June's scrolls. Upon reading Discussions with Metsli, it becomes clear that the skeleton, the one that you killed, was in fact June and - now listen carefully - was resurrected by Tep many thousands of years ago!
Only one issue hasn't been explained yet - the painted Zem tablet... You found another tablet with the same image of him, right? The demon! Did the Zem really see him with their own eyes?
Listen to what I have been told by our colleagues from Eljune while you were gone. It seems that goblins, while attempting to sell the Holy Weapon to the League and Empire, let it slip that those weapons are being developed at the mafia's factory by their engineer Sarang Petosiris. He is the only remaining person local to this Plateau. This means that he was resurrected right here, on this allod, thousands of years ago! And possibly, he was a witness to many of the events that took place here.
It would be great if we could talk with him! But how? For one thing, he works for the goblins, and secondly, he quite probably worships Tep... Yet again, I cannot do this without your help. It's possible that we will have to force a confession out of him.

Enough... Stop it!
Damnit, Jim! I'm a scientist, not a fighter! You've got to stop sneaking up on me like that!
Oh... You're not him. What do you want from me?

I will die before I say anything!
What? Rip out all the gears? From me?! Why you... Why you... Why, I'll...
Darn you anyway, ask! I have lived for many centuries, and I don't want to croak it again in my old age because of some greenhorn. So, what do you want to know?
Sneak into Blackjack's Bid and find out who bought the Artifacts.

If the League bought all the Artifacts... We'll be ruined! But there's one good thing about all this - they planned to destroy the Artifacts, instead of using them against us... but what if they change their minds?
Great Nezeb, what we are going to do? First we need to be sure that the League was definitely the buyer. We need to penetrate Blackjack's Bid and find proof of this deal.

Oh, thank you, we had already lost all hope of escaping! And what are you doing here?
You finally heard that the goblins sold all the artifacts? Don't worry, they weren't bought by the League.
The deal was made right in front of our eyes, we know who the customer was!
Sneak into Blackjack's Bid and find out who bought the Artifacts.

If the Empire, the darkness incarnate and henchmen of the demons, is controlling the artifacts, then what will that mean? Could it mean that we will lose this war?!
We need to calm down and collect ourselves... And make sure that this is really the case. We have no choice, we will have to penetrate the den of the mafia and find the proof.

The deal was made right in front of our eyes, we know who the customer was!
Pass on this knowledge to Bertille de Pluie at the Prospectors' Inn.

Tep? How dare you speak his name! No, no! Don't kill me! Okay, I'll tell you everything.
Tep was the greatest of all the mages that have lived on Sarnaut, and in a past life, I had the great honor of assisting one of his aides! At the time, Tep was studying June magic.
...What else do you want to know?
Yes, the legendary Curse of the June was a demon. Really, no one knew this until now? How odd... I saw him then like I am seeing you now and perhaps one day you will see him too... Why? What do you mean, why? Well, it's alive somewhere...
Of course it's alive! What else did you think? When I saw it last, it was still chasing the June. Of course, they don't exist anymore. But there are still many with June blood in their veins! Why do you think the Astral demons look exactly like the Curse? It's somewhere among them. Incredible, to know so little about the world in which you live!
Can I go now and start fixing the damage, caused by this battle with you?

Did you really talk with Sarang Petosiris? I never would have believed that it would actually work!
Come on, tell me everything he told you. Quickly!
Take the Historians' Bill from the Mafia Leader, Blackjack the Rich and explain everything to the Commissioner, Semer Kiya, at the Imperial Camp.

The artifacts were purchased by the Historians.
How would we know what they want them for? Probably to study history, right?
We didn't even know that the Historians had that much gold!
If you need further proof, you can get it from Blackjack, the head of this entire goblin mafia. He has the bill! You can probably find him at the loading dock.
They are still offloading the artifacts. You wouldn't believe how many boxes there are!
We want to get out of here as fast as we can. Farewell and good luck!
Have you got the proof? Did the League buy the artifacts from the mafia?
Historians? What do you mean, Historians? Just what side are they on - ours or the League?
Take the Historians' Bill from the Mafia Leader, Blackjack the Rich and explain everything to the Great Inquisitor, Afanasy Firov, at the League Camp.

Historians?! What an unexpected twist!
Where did they get so much gold? What are they planning?
Extinguish the demonic energy of the Dark Artifacts from the 6 Zem Pillars on Husk Isle with the Demonic Power Absorber and report the results to Pascal de Vevre at the Demon Hunters' Camp.

So there's nothing wrong with Anastasia? That's good to hear. We can start on compiling the detectors' data. Let's see here...
Hmm, what a strange situation! It's a known fact that the Artifacts of Light have all of a sudden become Dark. But at the same time, there are no traces of demons or demon worshippers on the Plateau. Here are facts! Everything is clear!
What does this mean?
No, since we're here already, we need to study these artifacts in full. Their turning from Light to Dark obviously has demonic nature. I will give you another one of our magical instruments – a demonic power absorber. It has saved the lives of many hunters!
Go to the nearest anomaly on Husk Isle test it on the artifacts.

The pillars have a demon guarding them?!
Then it's true! We are here for a reason! The darkness that has penetrated the Artifacts is demonic in nature.
Well... It looks like arrived just in time!
Accompany Lenta the Roughneck across the Cordon and report back to the Tussling Family.

Oh, those Prospectors... There is still a battle raging on the bridge and they're already rearing to jump into the thick of it.
Hah, just look at that one. Lenta the Roughneck! Prospector! We think she's a fool! She somehow got this notion into her head that she can make a quick gold and then find some quiet Orc and settle down peacefully, away from the others. We just can't get it through her thick skull that she can get killed here. She's constantly bothering us, saying "Send me across the Cordon! Send me across the Cordon!"
If you don't have anything better to do, would you mind accompanying this daredevil to the other side? We can't stand her anymore!
Did you get her across? Is she out of our hair?
Don't be too happy! This is only the first step, the real danger lies beyond the Cordon!
Take the Historians' Bill to the Imperial Diplomat Anatoly Aldanov in Asee-Teph.

Okay, look, here's what we need to do now... You must take this bill to our Imperial Diplomat, Anatoly Aldanov, as soon as you can! You can find him in Asee-Teph, near the Tensess Temple.
He needs to shake up his networks - why do the Historians need so many Dark Artifacts?
And, most importantly, what is threatening the Holy Land, why are goblins suddenly fleeing from the allod?
Have you got any good news?

A bill for Dark Artifacts?
What do they need them for? Where did they get the money for this purchase?
There is something very fishy here!
Bring the Historians' Bill of Sale to Klavdius Trojanov.

You must deliver the bill to the League diplomat, Klavdius Trojanov, as soon as you can! You can find him in Asee-Teph, near the Tensess Temple.
It's imperative that we find out why the Historians are collecting the Dark Artifacts.
And don't forget the most urgent question! What is threatening the Holy Land, why are goblins fleeing the allod?

Okay, so we know that the artifacts were bought by the Historians.
But what for? And where did they get the money? What are they planning to do with them? And the most important issue - how well are they protecting the boxes of artifacts! They could easily be stolen by the Empire, maybe they have already tried to steal them!
Ugh, all of this is making me dizzy.
Catapult yourself over the Cordon, launch a Signal Rocket, and return to Leonard de Vevre at the Historians' Camp.

Great we've got this catapult all set up!
Hmm... We need some way to test it out though. So, how would you like to be the first to try it? I'm sure it's safe! And, hey, we have Tensess' Gift on our side, so even if you die, you'll come back. ...Well, that is, if you don't lose your head somewhere along the way. But don't worry about any of that. It's like, 98% sure to work!
So how about it? Just climb up there and you'll be past the Cordon in no time. Oh! I almost forgot. Here, take this and fire it when you land. Just so we know you made over safe.
How did it go? You didn't die, did you?
Wonderful! We'll start sending Historians over immediately!
Place the Demonic Power Absorber in a crate of Dark Artifacts at the dock at Blackjack's Bid. Kill the Ferocious Demon Scout and return to Pascal de Vevre at the Demon Hunter's camp.

We must purify the artifacts that have already been taken! I'm sure that if we place the absorber near large concentrations of dark artifacts, then...
Hmm, well, I guess I don't really know what will happen. But we must try! We must cleanse the artifacts to keep this plague from spreading. But where?
The League and Empire have too little, we need a big concentration... That leaves only one place. Blackjack's Bid! If there ever was a large concentration of artifacts, it is there! Go there, to their dock, and find a chest, box - anything! Anything that the dark artifacts might be stored in. That's where we'll put the absorber.
I have no idea what will happen, but I can guess that there will be fighting. So be ready to vanquish the enemy!
I feel that with the artifacts are the cause of all Coba Plateau's troubles...

So it's true all true! The presence of the cultists and demons are confirmed! Look, if the rumors are true, and the cultist and demons did break into the Tensess Temple... Then Tensess' soul id in grave danger! By purging the artifacts, we help Tensess confront the darkness. Yes, this is a case for the hunters!
Speak with Braid the Bloodthirsty in the Central Imperial Camp in Asee-Teph on behalf of the Demon Hunters.

Now our task here is clear! We'll arm all our hunters with absorbers and dispatch them immediately to all areas of Coba Plateau to disarm the pillars. But that's not enough! A huge number of artifacts are located at both the League and the Imperial Camps!
You must go to Asee-Teph and... Who do you have there? A Chief? A sentry? Oh, right! The Colonel... Braid the Bloodthirsty? Go to him! Tell him everything that we have been able to find out. Tell him that the source of the darkness in the Tensess Temple is caused by the cultists and that we can help Tensess resist the darkness if we cleanse all the collected artifacts!
Oh... dark artifacts. That's the responsibility of the Council, Ugh, alright, fine. I'll see what I can do.
Speak with Esther de Desirae in the Central League Camp in Asee-Teph on behalf of the Demon Hunters.

Now our task here is clear! We'll arm all our hunters with absorbers and dispatch them immediately to all areas of Coba Plateau to disarm the pillars. But that's not enough! A huge number of artifacts are located at both the League and the Imperial Camps!
You must go to Asee-Teph and... Who do you have there? A Chief? A defender? Oh, right! The Archmage, Esther de Desirae? Go to her! Tell her everything that we have been able to find out. Tell her that the source of the darkness in the Tensess Temple is caused by the cultists and that we can help Tensess resist the darkness if we cleanse all the collected artifacts!
Oh, what to do... Everyone is screaming at everyone else that the world is going to be enveloped in darkness. You can be sure that if I ever get my hands on any artifacts, they will be destroyed!
Find a translator for this letter amongst the goblins at the Imperial Camp.

There must be just one goblin worker of ours that's loyal to the Empire!
For goodness sake! We're feeding and housing them, we're giving them work, we're giving them... Er... Very little money. But still! Go talk to the goblins, ask around, maybe one of them will translate this letter for us.
There must be one! I don't believe that not one of those scoundrels will talk to you.

"Just as we agreed. It's dropped off. Pick it up. On the day after tomorrow there will be more. Same place. In three caches. At the Kobold Knoll. First cache near..."
What rotten grammar! But at least we know what they're up to now!
Kill Red Band Bandits and take 6 Red Bands from their corpses for Gorislav Gipitsky at the Inn.

I've always tried to be kind to everybody! But people start to take advantage of that... Emelian Razin has been muddying the waters for a long time. He surrounded himself with Prospectors that have put on Red Bands, proclaimed themselves "the Chosen Ones" and "the old guard," but they're just a band of hooligans. I've heard that they even attack the other Prospectors. I didn't believe it until I saw with my own eyes when they attacked Artemis after a disagreement about his prices.
That's it! I've had enough! Razin's band are outlaws! If you meet them somewhere - don't hesitate to kill them. And the rest of you - do you hear me? I will pay a reward for each Red Band taken off their bodies!
It saddens me that the Prospectors are attacking each other. But the Red Band bandits have crossed the line.
They thought they could control us and force their laws on us... And where are they now? Freedom above all!
